//: Hand-authored intent layer for the flow manifest. The generator (scripts/build-flow-manifest.mjs) computes the dependency + consumer graph automatically; THIS file encodes what imports can't reveal — package roles and the ordered trunk flows. Edit this when a flow's shape changes; re-run `pnpm manifest`. Sources: CLAUDE.md, docs/PRODUCTION_ORCHESTRATION.md, docs/LOGISTICS_AND_FULFILLMENT.md, .claude/memory.

roles.@ilaunchify/db: Prisma schema + CockroachDB client + seeds. Substrate for everything.
roles.@ilaunchify/ui: Shared primitives, fonts, theme.css, tailwind preset.
roles.@ilaunchify/auth: Auth.js v5 + tier helpers + centralized ownership guards (tenant isolation = threat #1).
roles.@ilaunchify/audit: Append-only AuditLog writer (logAudit/logAuditAs/logSystemAudit). Every mutation must call it.
roles.@ilaunchify/plans: Tier / plan / fee lookups. Every billable or gated action consults it.
roles.@ilaunchify/notifications: Dispatcher + Resend. Every user-facing state change should emit here.
roles.@ilaunchify/orders: Order routing (owner-pinned manufacturing) + manifest gen + FC selection (fc-selector/fc-scorer) + order-fsm/dispatch-fsm.
roles.@ilaunchify/shipping: Logistics substrate: classifier, carrier eligibility + rate shop, EasyPost gateway, dispatch gates, channel-inbound gates. Prisma-free by design.
roles.@ilaunchify/nutrition: FDA label math — single source. calculateLabel + toPanelData.
roles.@ilaunchify/compliance-client: FDA rule packs + label validator (calls the Python service).
roles.@ilaunchify/risk: Risk taxonomy + PRS + MONITOR→WARN→GATE→ACT ladder; capacity gate at checkout.
roles.@ilaunchify/academy: Two learning sites CMS + three-level model + fsm.
roles.@ilaunchify/ai: LLM client + recipe parsing (parseRecipe) + prompts + telemetry. Haiku-backed.

flows.title: Order fulfillment (the orchestration trunk)
flows.note: Manufacturing is OWNER-PINNED (ProductTemplate.manufacturerServiceId); only commodity legs route. Do not touch findRouting until D1–D4 are locked.

guards: FSM helper (GAP: no packages ProductTemplate FSM home yet)

flows.title: Partner onboarding → activation → tier
flows.note: The Partner lifecycle FSM currently lives only in apps/admin/src/lib/partner-fsm.ts; partner-app onboarding transitions bypass it (known GAP).

substrate.//: Cross-cutting concerns every write touches. A build that skips one is the most common 'unwired' failure.
substrate.everyStateChange: an FSM helper (order-fsm / dispatch-fsm / partner-fsm / academy fsm / support)
